basic_details.job_title: Vikhyat Projects Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 5 Electrician, HVAC Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: Vikhyat Projects Private Limited, a private company, will hold walk-in interviews on 1 December 2026 (Tuesday) for Electrician and on 2 December 2026 (Wednesday) for HVAC Technician. Reporting time is 10:00 AM at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University, Fursatganj, Amethi-229302. There are 4 Electrician (Skilled) and 1 HVAC Technician (Highly Skilled) posts for deployment at RGNAU, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, with pay as per Government of India minimum wages (Advertisement No. VPPL/ADVR/11/07, dated 10th Nov, 2026). RGNAU has no role in the selection process.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is 18 years and above and not exceeding 40 years. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. The upper age limit may be relaxed at the discretion of the employer depending upon experience, suitability and institutional requirements.

content_sections.heading: About Vikhyat Projects
content_sections.text: Vikhyat Projects Pvt. Ltd has its registered office at 203, IInd Floor, Anupam Plaza, Plot No. 3 LSC, Mayur Vihar Phase-I, New Delhi-110091. The company invites applications for deployment of manpower at one of its client's locations, Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. This is a private engagement through the company, not a recruitment by RGNAU.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice says the number of vacancies in any category may increase or decrease depending upon the requirement. Employer's contribution towards EPF and ESI (wherever applicable) is borne by the employer. The notice prints no rupee amount for the pay. Essential qualification, either of the following: 10th Pass from a recognized Board with ITI Certificate in Electrician/Wireman/Electronics Mechanic trade from a recognized Institute, with minimum two year of experience as electrician/wireman. OR Diploma in Electrical/electronic Engineering from a recognized institution/university, with minimum one year of experience as electrician/wireman. Desirable qualification: Ability to carry out repair and maintenance of electrical wiring, switches, sockets, lights, fans, MCBs, distribution boards, electrical fittings and other electrical installations in university buildings, offices, hostels, laboratories and other facilities. Ability to identify electrical faults and attend to routine/emergency electrical complaints. 3 or more years' experience, preferably in a Government office, University, institutional campus, hotel, hospital, residential complex or similar large establishment. Possession of a valid Wireman Licence issued by the competent authority, wherever applicable, for carrying out electrical installation, repair and maintenance work. Essential qualification, any one of the following: 10th Pass from a recognized Board with ITI Certificate in RAC (Refrigeration and Air conditioning)/Electrician trade from a recognized institution, with a minimum of three years of experience in handling air conditioning and refrigeration. OR Diploma in Electrical/Refrigeration and Air Conditioning/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution/university, with a minimum of two years of experience in handling air conditioning and refrigeration systems, specializing in HVAC systems. OR SSC passed with a minimum of five years of experience in handling air conditioning and refrigeration systems, specializing in HVAC systems. Desirable qualification: Experience and knowledge in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of HVAC systems, including Chillers, AHUs, VRF/VRV and Central Air Conditioning Systems, HVAC control systems, electrical panels, energy-efficient operation, preventive maintenance, HVAC safety standards, maintenance documentation and energy management practices, preferably in universities, colleges, hospitals or other large institutional buildings. Knowledge and experience in the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of Daikin make HVAC system. Experience and knowledge in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Split/window AC systems of any make. The age limit for both posts is 18 years and above and not exceeding 40 years. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. The upper age limit may be relaxed at the discretion of the employer depending upon experience, suitability and institution

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to submit the following on the walk-in day: The Employment Application Form (printed on page 6 of the notice), with a passport size photograph pasted on it. Self-attested copies of relevant documents, submitted along with the application form at the time of walk-in. All original documents for verification, which shortlisted candidates must produce during the Test/Interaction/Skill Test. The form asks for the post applied for, full name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, gender, nationality, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC/EWS), whether PwBD, marital status, Aadhaar number (optional), permanent and correspondence address, mobile number, email ID, educational qualification (10th, 12th, ITI or other relevant course) and experience, if any. It ends with a declaration and the applicant's signature.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates walk in for the test and/or interaction on the date for their post. The notice says applications received from eligible candidates are scrutinized and only shortlisted candidates are called for Test/Interaction/Skill Evaluation, as applicable. Mere qualification may not ensure shortlisting, and Vikhyat Projects may apply higher than minimum cut-off criteria to ensure a reasonable number of candidates. Shortlisted candidates are informed by phone or email only. Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM may not be permitted to take part in the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What are the walk-in dates for Vikhyat Projects Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in for Electrician is on 1 December 2026 (Tuesday) and for HVAC Technician on 2 December 2026 (Wednesday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 10:00 AM for all positions. The venue is Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University, Fursatganj, Amethi-229302. Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM may not be permitted to take part.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 04 (Four) Electrician and 01 (One) HVAC Technician. The notice says the number may increase or decrease depending upon the requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Electrician?
faq.answer: 10th Pass from a recognized Board with ITI Certificate in Electrician/Wireman/Electronics Mechanic trade and minimum two years of experience as electrician/wireman, OR Diploma in Electrical/electronic Engineering with minimum one year of such experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for HVAC Technician?
faq.answer: 10th Pass with ITI Certificate in RAC/Electrician trade and minimum three years of experience, OR a Diploma in Electrical/Refrigeration and Air Conditioning/Mechanical Engineering with minimum two years, OR SSC passed with minimum five years of experience in air conditioning and refrigeration systems, specializing in HVAC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 years and above and not exceeding 40 years. The employer may relax the upper limit depending upon experience, suitability and institutional requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is as per Government of India minimum wages applicable for Skilled (Electrician) and Highly Skilled (HVAC Technician) categories, as amended from time to time. No other allowances or benefits are paid.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit self-attested copies of relevant documents with the application form at the walk-in. Shortlisted candidates must produce all originals for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job with RGNAU?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual and co-terminus with the contract awarded to Vikhyat Projects Private Limited by RGNAU, and gives no right to regular appointment or absorption in RGNAU.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to attend the Test/Interaction.
